published_prior_art.cite: LiangRecht2025 fixes independent toggling; GuoLiang2026 optimizes a different OLS E-optimal criterion within random-switch laws.
TellamburaGuoBarton1998 studies deterministic complementary training pairs and information matrices; DavisJedwab1999 supplies the Golay-pair construction, not a one-path design-based minimax theorem.
BandeiraKunisky2018 characterizes degree-four pseudomoments, explicitly as a relaxation rather than the proposed genuine binary-law lag projection.

novelty_flags.label: Project-level fourth-order-design survey
novelty_flags.one_line: Add Thiyageswaran et al., arXiv:2601.17145, Appendix F.3: it explicitly identifies fourth-order Rademacher MSE objectives, although its graph-interference Gaussian relaxation neither gives the proposed exact realizable-path minimax result nor subsumes it.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies an LTI impulse-response model, a method-of-moments causal estimator, and higher moments under its independent-toggling design.
Theorem 4.6 minimizes a robust E-optimal OLS criterion over random-switch parameters and sends its minimizers to (1/2,1/2), i.e. i.i.d. Bernoulli assignment.
The paper formulates switchback design as minimax discrete optimization, identifies a worst-case adversary, and solves a reduced problem through continuous relaxation.

source_verification_receipts.version: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory 45(7), 1999 author-hosted publication PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3 gives affine quadratic Boolean functions whose paired sequences are Golay complementary pairs.
The paper studies deterministic aperiodic training sequences and complementary pairs whose autocorrelation-matrix eigenvalues sum to a constant.
The article proves vanishing odd-point balanced Rudin–Shapiro correlations and analyzes even- and four-point correlations through recurrences.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.3, interpretation of Theorem 2.15 as a relaxation
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The degree-four generalized elliptope is treated as a pseudomoment relaxation of the cut polytope, not as a characterization of genuine binary-law moments.
The work supplies a convex relaxation and randomized feasible input with a 2/pi information guarantee, not an exact fourth-order causal-risk optimum.

source_verification_receipts.version: IRE Transactions on Information Theory 7(2), April 1961
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Golay's cited paper is the original complementary-series source for cancellation of nonzero aperiodic autocorrelations in a pair.
The preprint explicitly notes a Rademacher objective proportional to E[(xᵀLx)^2] and discusses a Gaussian relaxation; it does not establish the proposal's exact temporal one-path minimax result.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Thiyageswaran et al. (2026) as the closest fourth-order-design antecedent and state precisely that its Gaussian/covariance relaxation is orthogonal to exact realizable temporal fourth moments.

Add a short boundary corollary that places the iid-optimality threshold beside GuoLiang2026's E-optimal random-switch limit, explicitly distinguishing the two criteria on their common impulse-response submodel.
Include a fully displayed T=4 mirrored-law table and an L=8 Golay-block tensor calculation from primitives as auditable worked instances of both constructions.

recommended_next_step: Revise the related-work survey to incorporate the missed fourth-order design preprint, then advance the field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
